```{=html}
<div class="sm-shell">

<header class="sm-topbar">
  <div class="sm-deck-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Choose a deck">
    <button class="sm-tab active" data-deck="ir362" role="tab" aria-selected="true">📘 IR 362</button>
    <button class="sm-tab" data-deck="acct410x" role="tab">📕 ACCT 410</button>
    <button class="sm-tab" data-deck="econ205" role="tab">📗 ECON 205</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-meta">
    <span id="sm-counter">— / —</span>
    <span class="sm-dot">·</span>
    <span id="sm-mastery">— mastered</span>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="sm-progressbar"><div id="sm-progressfill"></div></div>

<main class="sm-stage" id="sm-stage" tabindex="0">
  <div class="sm-card" id="sm-card">
    <div class="sm-card-inner" id="sm-card-inner">
      <div class="sm-card-face sm-card-front">
        <div class="sm-face-label">Question</div>
        <div class="sm-face-content" id="sm-q">Loading…</div>
        <div class="sm-tap-hint">Tap card or press <kbd>Space</kbd> to flip</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sm-card-face sm-card-back">
        <div class="sm-face-label">Answer</div>
        <div class="sm-face-content" id="sm-a"></div>
        <div class="sm-rate-row">
          <button class="sm-rate sm-rate-hard" data-rating="hard">
            <span class="sm-rate-key">1</span><span class="sm-rate-label">Hard</span>
          </button>
          <button class="sm-rate sm-rate-good" data-rating="good">
            <span class="sm-rate-key">2</span><span class="sm-rate-label">Good</span>
          </button>
          <button class="sm-rate sm-rate-easy" data-rating="easy">
            <span class="sm-rate-key">3</span><span class="sm-rate-label">Easy</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sm-controls">
    <button class="sm-ctrl" id="sm-prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button>
    <button class="sm-ctrl" id="sm-flip" title="Flip (Space)">↻ Flip</button>
    <button class="sm-ctrl" id="sm-next" title="Next (→)">→</button>
  </div>

  <div class="sm-secondary">
    <button class="sm-link" id="sm-shuffle">Shuffle deck</button>
    <button class="sm-link" id="sm-reset">Reset deck</button>
    <button class="sm-link" id="sm-due">Due only</button>
  </div>
</main>

<footer class="sm-shortcuts">
  <kbd>Space</kbd> flip · <kbd>1</kbd> hard · <kbd>2</kbd> good · <kbd>3</kbd> easy · <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd> nav · <kbd>S</kbd> shuffle · swipe on mobile
</footer>

<div class="sm-celebrate" id="sm-celebrate" hidden>
  <div class="sm-cel-card">
    <div class="sm-cel-emoji">🎉</div>
    <h2>Deck cleared</h2>
    <p id="sm-cel-stats">— / — easy · — good · — hard</p>
    <div class="sm-cel-actions">
      <button class="sm-cel-btn" id="sm-cel-again">Run it again</button>
      <button class="sm-cel-btn sm-cel-btn-secondary" id="sm-cel-next">Next deck</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

</div>

<style>
.sm-shell {
  max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; padding: .8rem 1rem 2rem;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;
}
.sm-topbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sm-deck-tabs { display: flex; gap: .35rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sm-tab {

  font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; color: #5b5450;

.sm-meta { font-size: .82rem; color: #5b5450; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; }

}

}

  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;

}
.sm-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 720px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 11;

  text-align: center; max-height: 100%; overflow-y: auto;
}

.sm-card-back .sm-face-content { font-size: 1.18rem; font-weight: 500; }

.sm-rate-good { background: rgba(212,164,55,.18); color: #7e5f1f; border-color: rgba(212,164,55,.4); }
.sm-rate-good:hover { background: rgba(212,164,55,.28); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(212,164,55,.22); }
.sm-rate-easy { background: rgba(139,157,107,.18); color: #5a6a40; border-color: rgba(139,157,107,.4); }
.sm-rate-easy:hover { background: rgba(139,157,107,.28); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(139,157,107,.22); }

.sm-controls { display: flex; gap: .6rem; align-items: center; }
.sm-ctrl {
  background: #fefcf8; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: .55rem 1.1rem;

  color: #5b5450; transition: all .2s ease;
}
.sm-ctrl:hover { background: #8a2424; color: #fbf8f3; border-color: #8a2424; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(138,36,36,.18); }
.sm-secondary {
  display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center;
  font-size: .85rem;
}
.sm-link {
  background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer;

}

.sm-shortcuts {

}

.sm-celebrate {

}
.sm-cel-card {

}

.sm-cel-emoji { font-size: 3.6rem; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
.sm-cel-card h2 { font-size: 1.7rem; margin: 0 0 .35rem; color: #8a2424; font-weight: 800; }

.sm-cel-btn {

  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.sm-cel-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(138,36,36,.25); }
.sm-cel-btn-secondary { background: rgba(0,0,0,.05); color: #5b5450; }
.sm-cel-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.10); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.10); }

body.quarto-dark .sm-card-front {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1c2128 0%, #161a20 100%);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
body.quarto-dark .sm-card-back {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(212,164,55,.12) 0%, rgba(138,36,36,.18) 100%);
}
body.quarto-dark .sm-face-content { color: #f5e9df; }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .sm-card { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }
  .sm-face-content { font-size: 1.15rem; }

}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sm-card-inner { transition: none; }

</style>

<script>
(function(){
  const ROOT = (() => {
    const a = document.querySelector(".navbar a[href$='index.html'], .navbar a[href$='/']");
    return a ? a.getAttribute("href").replace(/index\.html$/, "") : "./";
  })();

  const STATE_KEY = "studyhub_sm_v1";
  const TABS = document.querySelectorAll(".sm-tab");
  const Q = document.getElementById("sm-q");
  const A = document.getElementById("sm-a");
  const CARD = document.getElementById("sm-card");
  const COUNTER = document.getElementById("sm-counter");
  const MASTERY = document.getElementById("sm-mastery");
  const FILL = document.getElementById("sm-progressfill");
  const STAGE = document.getElementById("sm-stage");
  const CEL = document.getElementById("sm-celebrate");

  let allCards = [];
  let deck = "ir362";
  let order = [];
  let idx = 0;
  let state = {};
  let stats = { hard: 0, good: 0, easy: 0 };
  let dueOnly = false;

  // Convert markdown-ish strong syntax to HTML
  function md(text){
    return text
      .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>")
      .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, "<em>$1</em>");
  }

  function loadState(){
    try { state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STATE_KEY)) || {}; }
    catch(e) { state = {}; }
  }
  function saveState(){
    try { localStorage.setItem(STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch(e){}
  }

  function deckCards(){
    return allCards.filter(c => c.deck === deck);
  }

  function buildOrder(){
    const cards = deckCards();
    const due = cards.filter(c => !state[c.id] || state[c.id] === "hard");
    if (dueOnly && due.length) order = due.slice();
    else order = cards.slice();
    // missed-first
    order.sort((a, b) => {
      const ar = state[a.id] || "new"; const br = state[b.id] || "new";
      const w = { hard: 0, new: 1, good: 2, easy: 3 };
      return (w[ar] ?? 1) - (w[br] ?? 1);
    });
    idx = 0;
  }

  function shuffle(){
    for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]];
    }
    idx = 0; render();
  }

  function render(){
    const cards = deckCards();
    const mastered = cards.filter(c => state[c.id] === "easy" || state[c.id] === "good").length;
    MASTERY.textContent = `${mastered} mastered`;
    if (!order.length) {
      Q.innerHTML = "Empty deck.";
      A.innerHTML = "";
      COUNTER.textContent = "0 / 0";
      FILL.style.width = "0%";
      return;
    }
    const card = order[idx];
    Q.innerHTML = md(card.q);
    A.innerHTML = md(card.a);
    COUNTER.textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${order.length}`;
    FILL.style.width = `${((idx + 1) / order.length) * 100}%`;
    CARD.classList.remove("flipped");
  }

  function flip(){ CARD.classList.toggle("flipped"); }

  function next(){
    if (idx < order.length - 1) { idx++; render(); }
    else { celebrate(); }
  }
  function prev(){
    if (idx > 0) { idx--; render(); }
  }

  function rate(rating){
    const card = order[idx];
    if (!card) return;
    state[card.id] = rating;
    stats[rating] = (stats[rating] || 0) + 1;
    saveState();
    next();
  }

  function celebrate(){
    document.getElementById("sm-cel-stats").textContent =
      `${order.length} cards · ${stats.easy} easy · ${stats.good} good · ${stats.hard} hard`;
    CEL.hidden = false;
    if (window.shConfetti) window.shConfetti();
  }
  document.getElementById("sm-cel-again").addEventListener("click", () => {
    stats = { hard: 0, good: 0, easy: 0 };
    buildOrder(); render(); CEL.hidden = true;
  });
  document.getElementById("sm-cel-next").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const decks = ["ir362", "acct410x", "econ205"];
    const i = decks.indexOf(deck);
    deck = decks[(i + 1) % decks.length];
    setActiveTab(); stats = { hard: 0, good: 0, easy: 0 };
    buildOrder(); render(); CEL.hidden = true;
  });

  function setActiveTab(){
    TABS.forEach(t => {
      const a = t.dataset.deck === deck;
      t.classList.toggle("active", a);
      t.setAttribute("aria-selected", a ? "true" : "false");
    });
  }
  TABS.forEach(t => t.addEventListener("click", () => {
    deck = t.dataset.deck; setActiveTab(); stats = { hard: 0, good: 0, easy: 0 };
    buildOrder(); render();
  }));

  CARD.addEventListener("click", flip);
  document.getElementById("sm-flip").addEventListener("click", flip);
  document.getElementById("sm-next").addEventListener("click", next);
  document.getElementById("sm-prev").addEventListener("click", prev);
  document.getElementById("sm-shuffle").addEventListener("click", shuffle);
  document.getElementById("sm-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!confirm("Reset progress for this deck?")) return;
    deckCards().forEach(c => { delete state[c.id]; });
    saveState(); buildOrder(); render();
    if (window.shToast) window.shToast("Deck reset");
  });
  document.getElementById("sm-due").addEventListener("click", () => {
    dueOnly = !dueOnly; buildOrder(); render();
    if (window.shToast) window.shToast(dueOnly ? "Showing due only" : "Showing all");
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".sm-rate").forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); rate(b.dataset.rating); });
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const tag = (e.target?.tagName || "").toLowerCase();
    if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select" || e.target?.isContentEditable) return;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
    if (CEL.hidden === false) return;
    if (e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); flip(); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); next(); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); prev(); }
    else if (e.key === "1") { rate("hard"); }
    else if (e.key === "2") { rate("good"); }
    else if (e.key === "3") { rate("easy"); }
    else if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "s") { shuffle(); }
  });

  // Touch swipe
  let touchX = null;
  STAGE.addEventListener("touchstart", e => { touchX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  STAGE.addEventListener("touchend", e => {
    if (touchX === null) return;
    const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchX;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 60) { dx < 0 ? next() : prev(); }
    touchX = null;
  });

  // Load card data
  fetch(ROOT + "assets/js/flashcard-data.json")
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
      allCards = data;
      loadState();
      buildOrder();
      render();
    })
    .catch(err => {
      Q.innerHTML = "Could not load deck data.";
      console.error(err);
    });
})();
</script>
```
